text:
anya: FYI spun up a quick prototype of a "stipple" variant for the Console metric mini-map in dark mode. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/stipple-proto. Main asks: do micro-swatches hold up at 14px? Are code fences still legible with new ramp? Screenshot attached.
sam: Nice exploration. At 14px the tiny swatches lose definition if the darkest stop sits at the page bg. Two levers: lift darkest stop by ~8% luminance or apply a 1px inner stroke. Stipple for the lowest bucket looks promising.
marco: Rendering FYI 1: canvas gradients are using sRGB blending now; that can cause perceived banding vs perceptual ramps. Recommend testing a Lab/OKLCH-based spectral ramp baked into the sprite for consistent zoom/export.
lina: Accessibility: avoid color-only encoding for the lowest two buckets. Stipple + numeric microlabels (e.g., "003%", "4%") will help. Also tooltip copy should say "Frequency (%)" not just "Count".
contrast-bot: Auto-contrast-check: proposed legend text #b7c6d1 on bg #071018 -> contrast 4.3:1 (small text borderline). Suggest #d5e6f0 or semibold.
anya: Copy suggestion: numerical ranges instead of vague words. Proposed labels: "003%", "410%", "1130%", "31%+". Also include a brief caption on exported images explaining the stipple usage.
sam: Quick CSS sketch for inner stroke + focus:
```
.legend-swatch{width:30px;height:12px;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);stroke-width:1}
.code-block{background:#0f1214;color:#eaf5ff}
.canvas-cell.focus{outline:3px solid #2b6df6}
```
marco: For exports please bake the stipple as a lightweight alpha texture into the canvas paint pass to avoid DOM overhead. Use premultiplied alpha so strokes blend predictably in sRGB.
lina: Also add <title> and <desc> to exported SVGs and alt text for PNGs. Tooltip opacity should be ~0.94 on dark mode and include a 2px shadow so it doesn't read as ghosted. Keyboard focus must announce "Row X, Column Y: Z%".
anya: Plan: Sam -> update Figma frames (stroke + stipple); Marco -> prototype baked stipple in demo branch; Lina -> a11y copy + sample alt text. Will run quick internal A/B with PMs.
sam: Poll in-thread: inner stroke (:+1:) or stipple (:-1:)?
contrast-bot: Poll status: inner stroke 2, stipple 3.
anya: Thanks folks. I'll collect metrics feedback and iterate. Thread closed until demos land.
